corpus.en: A spirit does not guard the sailors.
The guardians did not warn the sailor.
The spirit did not guard the stables.
The spirits did not guard the captains.

toEnglish.explanation: O S V order. tikelte-ti-me-se = captain-PL-DEF-ACC; mata-tu-ma = guardian-PL-DEF; kuva-na = guard-PST.
O S V order. teltivi-ti-se = stable-PL-ACC; telelke-ti = spirit-PL; kuva-na = guard-PST.

toLang.prompt: The guardians do not warn the sailors.
toLang.explanation: O S V order. tamu-tu-ma-sa = sailor-PL-DEF-ACC; mata-tu-ma = guardian-PL-DEF; la = NEG; seke = warn.

toLang.prompt: Spirits do not guard the sailor.
toLang.explanation: O S V order. tamu-ma-sa = sailor-DEF-ACC; telelke-ti = spirit-PL; la = NEG; kuva = guard.
S V order. telelke-ti = spirit-PL; la = NEG; tele-ne = whisper-PST.

grammar: Word order: object, subject, verb. With one participant: subject, verb.
Definite (“the”). A noun without it means “a” (or plain plural).
Past tense. Without it the verb is present or future.
Negation: a separate word before the verb.
explain.notes: Vowel harmony: a word's vowels are either all back (a, u) or all front (e, i), and suffix vowels follow the stem. Checked against 1305 alternative analyses; the sentences rule out 1303, including: -tu/-ti appears when: plural & two-participant clause; -ma/-me appears when: definite & animate.
